name: resturent-pos-system
description: Root orchestration: runs the Express backend (port 5001) and the Vite frontend (port 8080, which proxies /api to the backend) together, so a single `dev` command boots the whole system.

scripts.predev: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.dev: (cd Backend && npm run dev) & (cd Frontend && npm run dev -- --port 8080 --host --strictPort) & wait
